items.title: The Strait of Hormuz's impact on global markets: Game Changer of the Year Panel
items.summary:
The Strait of Hormuz is Yahoo Finance's 2026 Game Changer of the Year; it would be difficult to overstate the conflict's impact on global markets and the economy.Apollo Global Management (APO) partner and head of energy and infrastructure credit Daniel Vogel, Rystad Energy chief economist Claudio Galimberti, and CIBC Private Wealth senior energy trader Rebecca Babin join Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley at Yahoo Finance's 2026 Invest conference to discuss the state of oil (CL=F, BZ=F) prices, the future of the energy industry, and more.

Disclosure: Yahoo is a portfolio company of funds managed by affiliates of Apollo Global Management.

items.title: EasyJet investors back Apollo buyout as deal moves closer to completion
items.summary: Investing.com -- EasyJet shareholders approved Apollo’s takeover of the budget airline on Wednesday, clearing a key hurdle for the deal, which still requires court sanction and regulatory approvals and is expected to complete in the first quarter of 2027.

items.title: 12% of U.S. hospitals are owned by private equity
items.summary: As scrutiny over cost and quality at private equity-backed hospitals persists, a new tracker shows that PE hospital ownership has expanded nationwide and is concentrated among a handful of firms.

items.title: Musk “Would Never Lend Money” to Pure AI Clouds. Goldman Is Selling SpaceX’s $40 Billion GPU Debt
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGoldman Sachs and Apollo are marketing slices of a roughly $40 billion debt package that buys Nvidia chips for SpaceX to rent, Bloomberg reported. Elon Musk says he would never lend to a company that only makes money serving AI from a data center, and this deal is written so lenders can count on all of SpaceX, Starlink included, to pay the rent.
